name: Driving space and route flow
changes: Widened the racing surface from 10 to 13 metres.
Completed corner smoothing to a minimum radius of about 45 metres.
Moved the driving waypoints out to suit the wider road.
Increased clearance between the racing line and street buildings.
Changed Boxmeer's default race from two laps to one.

name: Road edges and surface continuity
changes: Lowered curbs to 5 cm and lengthened their bevels.
Widened and cut open the De Meidoorn entrance apron.
Aligned ground texture coordinates across terrain triangles.
Inset road texture sampling to reduce atlas-edge bleed.
Moved rural hedges back to provide a grass recovery margin.

name: Streets and housing
changes: Separated shopping streets from residential facade types.
Varied terrace frontage widths and introduced deliberate gaps.
Added detached-house setbacks, gardens and drives.
Added lower-pitched hipped roofs and terracotta roof variations.
Added window bays to exposed residential end walls.

name: Maasheggen landscape
changes: Replaced the old tree cutouts with original AI-generated summer foliage.
Rebuilt roadside hedges as continuous curved volumes.
Added more distant tree clumps to give the landscape depth.
Introduced coherent field-sized colour variation.
Replaced rural paved shoulders with grassy verges.

name: Recognizable landmarks
changes: Added belfry clocks, stringcourses and buttresses to the basilica.
Reworked the castle roofs, seated its roof cupola correctly, and added entrance pillars and a forecourt.
Gave De Weijer a park setting with a pond and trees.
Rebuilt Rochuskapel as a six-sided chapel with a cross.
Added a sheltered monastery entrance and paved forecourt.

name: Floralaan and De Meidoorn
changes: Refined the low-house wall, roof and solar-panel proportions.
Replaced heavy carport beams and brick posts with slender steel structures.
Painted parking bays into the driveway material.
Mounted readable street-name plates with separate front and rear faces.
Connected a De Meidoorn arm back to Floralaan as an optional drive-through route.

name: Street life and interaction
changes: Replaced flat lantern sprites with solid street lamps.
Added complete benches at public-space locations.
Added planted tubs around public forecourts.
Built a sheltered bus stop on Floralaan.
Added six movable cones using the native collision system.

name: Rendering and materials
changes: Subdivided road panels to remove the large blank near-camera texture patches.
Added transparent gutters around foliage cells to prevent edge streaks.
Adjusted brick and roof material repetition to a more believable scale.
Added cornice and gutter trim to selected building fronts.
Replaced the yellow dawn sky with an original AI-generated daylight sky.

name: Racing feedback and choices
changes: Placed warning chevrons ahead of the sharper bends.
Added Floralaan, Maasheggen and Centrum sector gates.
Varied turbo, repair and points pickups across the two driving lines.
Added a visible start/finish gate and non-colliding chequered paint.
Added low recovery rails outside selected bends.

name: Presentation and final driving feel
changes: Replaced atlas-crop menu pictures with actual rendered views of the map.
Replaced the loading image with an actual rendered Boxmeer view.
Added the side-street connection, clearer labels and sector shortcuts to the viewer map.
Made the direct preview a responsive, fully upgraded Kat car; stock preview remains available.
Added a gentle elevated dike with connected grass embankments.
